instruction: Change the IMAP server port for the primary account from 994 to 993 to use the standard IMAP SSL/TLS port.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing server port from 994 to 993. The evaluator verifies that mail.server.server1.port is set to 993 in prefs.js. Original value is 994.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM using get_vm_file
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js format and validates preferences
Expected value (port=993) semantically matches instruction requirement for standard IMAP SSL/TLS port
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the single requirement: verify port is changed to 993
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses rule.get('expect', {}) without incorrectly accessing rule.get('rules', {})
Verification logic is practical and will work at runtime - prefs.js is the standard Thunderbird configuration file and mail.server.server1.port is the correct preference key

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
